type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: post_verdict
functions.doc: Attach an AI verdict (hashes + TEE signature) to a disputed transfer. Judge only.

functions.name: report
functions.doc: Report a pending transfer or unwrap as theft. Attach exactly `report_bond`.

functions.name: resolve
functions.doc:
Council decision. `reverse = true` sends the funds to `refund_to` (default: the sender)
 and returns the bond to the reporter. `reverse = false` releases the funds to the receiver
 and gives the bond to the receiver as compensation.

functions.name: unwrap
functions.doc: Start an unwrap. The USDC can be withdrawn after the undo window (see `withdraw`).

functions.name: withdraw
functions.doc: Finish an unwrap whose window has passed. Anyone may call; USDC goes to the exit owner.

available.description: Spendable now (includes pending transfers whose window already passed).

disputed_in.description: Incoming transfers frozen by a report.

pending_in.description: Incoming transfers still inside the undo window.
